label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton initializes its format state using defaultFormat without persisting or recalling the user's previously selected format. We should update ExportButton to store and retrieve the chosen export format in localStorage so it is remembered across sessions.
